A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a fog node is a computing and communication system that provides the necessary infrastructure and services to support the execution of applications in the edge of the Internet, and that can be implemented by a variety of edge nodes, depending on the specific requirements and the available resources of each use case.

a fog node is an entity that can be deployed anywhere in the network, from the core network towards the edge of the physical network, and it has a set of functionalities to enable a variety of applications and services.

a fog node is an infrastructure, implemented through a variety, usually wireless, communication technologies, and a set of edge devices, which is capable of performing a subset of the functionalities of a data center.

fog computing is an umbrella term that encompasses a wide variety of technologies and concepts, which are not yet fully integrated into a common vision.
the fog node is not a specific edge device.
